description: Board-independent UNIVERSAL SECD runtime primitives. These are present in EVERY firmware image at FIXED ids, so a program compiled against this file runs unchanged on any target. Board-specific HAL primitives (ids >= 15) live in the per-chip JSON files; this file is the only source of truth for the portable runtime ids.
note: utf16-enc/utf16-dec are registered in src/core/primitives.cpp via secd_register_prim_at at 200/201, unconditionally (every firmware). Core VM ops 0-14 are registered sequentially first in every firmware, so their ids are stable here too.
